verdict.summary: Zucchini noodles themselves are gluten-free, but cross-contamination and added ingredients can pose a risk. Care should be taken to ensure no gluten-containing sauces or toppings are used.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.
